proof_scope: Race/staleness protection on the live bridge (#1441 vscode-races family): a stale agent command bound to an outdated stop sequence cannot control a newer pause, a command bound to the wrong session cannot control the current one, and a session-control command with no session binding is refused. Capability-gated on the live bridge.

claims.proves: the live bridge rejects an inspect whose expectedStopSequence does not match the current pause (naming both numbers), rejects an inspect bound to a nonexistent sessionId, and refuses session control with no sessionId at all
claims.does_not_prove: human-driven Step Over interleaving (needs the HUMAN capability) or multi-window race arbitration

cases.name: stale-stop-sequence-command-rejected
cases.description: Stop at a breakpoint, then issue an inspect bound to expectedStopSequence 999: the bridge must reject it as stale, naming the mismatch, instead of controlling the newer pause.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; [ -z "$WS" ] && { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; for attempt in 1 2; do OUT=$(uv run --project .. python ../scripts/request_vscode_bridge.py --workspace "$WS" --action restart --launch-config-name 'Debug nested ($debugger)' --break "$WS/skills/debugger/scenarios/variable_state/nested.py:12" --local payload --stop-timeout-ms 45000 --expect-extension-host-kind ui | tail -1); for i in $(seq 1 75); do sleep 2; S=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$OUT')).get('status'))" 2>/dev/null || echo pending); case "$S" in stopped|stopped-not-proof|error|terminated) break;; esac; done; case "$S" in stopped|stopped-not-proof) break;; esac; sleep 5; done; [ "$S" = stopped ] || [ "$S" = stopped-not-proof ] || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; SID=$(python3 -c "import json;print((json.load(open('$OUT')).get('stoppedState') or {}).get('sessionId',''))"); OUT2=$(uv run --project .. python ../scripts/request_vscode_bridge.py --workspace "$WS" --action inspect --session-id "$SID" --expected-stop-sequence 999 --local payload --stop-timeout-ms 15000 --expect-extension-host-kind ui | tail -1); for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 2; S2=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$OUT2')).get('status'))" 2>/dev/null || echo pending); case "$S2" in stopped|stopped-not-proof|error|terminated) break;; esac; done; E=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$OUT2')).get('error') or '')"); echo "stale-error: $E"; echo "$E" | grep -q 'stale inspect rejected' && echo STALE-COMMAND-REJECTED || exit 1

cases.name: wrong-session-command-rejected
cases.description: An inspect bound to a nonexistent sessionId is rejected instead of controlling whatever session is current.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; [ -z "$WS" ] && { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; OUT=$(uv run --project .. python ../scripts/request_vscode_bridge.py --workspace "$WS" --action inspect --session-id 'no-such-session-xyz' --local payload --stop-timeout-ms 15000 --expect-extension-host-kind ui | tail -1); for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 2; S=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$OUT')).get('status'))" 2>/dev/null || echo pending); case "$S" in stopped|stopped-not-proof|error|terminated) break;; esac; done; E=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$OUT')).get('error') or '')"); echo "error: $E"; [ "$S" = error ] && [ -n "$E" ] && echo WRONG-SESSION-REJECTED || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }

cases.name: session-control-without-binding-refused
cases.description: An inspect with no sessionId at all is refused up front (requires sessionId), never guessing a session.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; [ -z "$WS" ] && { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; OUT=$(uv run --project .. python ../scripts/request_vscode_bridge.py --workspace "$WS" --action inspect --local payload --stop-timeout-ms 10000 --expect-extension-host-kind ui | tail -1); for i in $(seq 1 20); do sleep 2; S=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$OUT')).get('status'))" 2>/dev/null || echo pending); case "$S" in stopped|stopped-not-proof|error|terminated) break;; esac; done; E=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$OUT')).get('error') or '')"); echo "error: $E"; echo "$E" | grep -q 'requires sessionId' && echo UNBOUND-CONTROL-REFUSED || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }
